description: coordinator-rules: at every context epoch (startup, resume, clear, compact), puts choi's rules into a session whose <config>/rules/ holds none of them — a project coordinator, or a cloud session without scripts/cloud-setup.sh. One entry per part, because the host caps each injected string at 10,000 characters and one command hands back one string; `1/4` means part 1 of 4. The rules fill three parts today, the fourth is headroom and emits nothing until they grow.
